title: Coherence of the recorded module pullback tensor comparison
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Equip module sheaves with their sheaf tensor [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Let $F:\operatorname{Mod}(O_X)\to\operatorname{Mod}(O_T)$ be a functor, with object identifications $h_M:F(M)=g^*M$ and arrow formula $F(a)=h_M;g^*(a);h_N^{-1}$ for the tensor-formula pullback [def-pc-module-pullback]. Write $e_{M,N}:g^*(M\otimes N)\cong g^*M\otimes g^*N$ for Classical.choose of the recorded comparison [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-tensor]. Then there exists a strong monoidal structure $m_F$ on $F$ whose inverse tensorator is $h_{M\otimes N};e_{M,N};(h_M^{-1}\otimes h_N^{-1})$. This statement concerns module sheaves only, not derived categories.

proof.text: Identify F with the tensor-formula pullback using the object equalities and the arrow formula. Naturality of the chosen e is part of the recorded comparison theorem. Its section formula identifies the two triple composites with the same pure triple tensor under the associator. Check after adjunction and sheafification, or on stalks where pure tensors generate; hence the associativity diagram commutes.

proof.text: Construct the unit comparison by multiplication O_T tensor_{g^{-1}O_X} g^{-1}O_X -> O_T, with inverse a -> a tensor 1. The balanced tensor relations make the maps inverse. The left and right unit diagrams both act as the identity on pure tensors. Thus the inverses of e and this unit comparison give CoreMonoidal. Transport through the specified object equalities yields the asserted eqToHom conjugation.
